lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good morning Jorge! Thanks for picking up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, yes, perfect timing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your energy been this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Better than last week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So last time your goal was to keep it to 2 drinks on the weekend. How did that go?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Only 1 days. We had a birthday party, there was so much food.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. Everything at the store costs so much.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days. My daughter keeps reminding me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you cook on Sundays?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. Work has been crazy, I'm doing overtime.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Easy for you to say.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is anyone else at home able to cook?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes. I can cook on Sunday and have it for a few days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to stop eating out so much.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, if I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Being around for my family is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. I made a big pot of lentils on Sunday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I cook at home 4 nights.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Jorge, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

tags.note: Reports one day met; names party barrier
Directive 'have to stop'; ignores change talk
Plan the night before as strategy
Moved on without reflecting family motivation

flags.reason: Directive 'You have to make this a priority' drew pushback at line 17; no permission sought.
'You have to stop eating out' is a directive that ignores Jorge's tentative 'Maybe' and his own plan.
Health-threat warning without permission; contrasts with Jorge's family-focused motivation at line 25.
Strong family-motivated change talk not reflected or explored; coach moved to a closed question.
Cost of groceries raised as barrier but not explored; possible food-access concern to check.

score.summary: Coach elicited useful change talk, including Jorge's Sunday batch-cooking idea and his goal of four home-cooked nights, but repeatedly used directives and warnings (lines 16, 20, 24) that met resistance. Reflections of Jorge's family motivation and cost barrier were missing, and no barrier planning or summary occurred.
strengths: Reviewed last week's drink goal at line 6 with an open question.
Elicited concrete change talk and a specific goal at lines 28-29.
Set a clear next contact at line 30.
coaching_tips: Replace 'You have to make this a priority' (line 16) with a reflection, e.g., 'Work is pulling hard against your cooking plans.'
Reflect Jorge's family motivation from line 25 before moving on, e.g., 'Being there for your family is a strong reason for you.'
Ask permission before advice, e.g., 'Would it be okay to talk about health risks?' instead of line 24's warning.
Explore the grocery cost barrier (line 9) with an open question before planning meals.
Close with a summary of his plan and barriers before setting the next contact.
